ep.title: Equivalence partitioning
ep.rules: Wallet rules: a payment amount is above 0 and at most {max}; the fraud service declines amounts above {threshold}. Categories: {categories}; GAMBLING is declined, any other string is a 422 error. Pick one value per partition.
ep.duplicates: Extra values — their partition is already covered: {values}
bva.title: Boundary value analysis
bva.rules: Wallet rules: the fraud service declines amounts above {threshold}; a valid amount is {min} to {max}; step 0.01. Pick a boundary and a BVA version.
dt.title: Decision table
dt.rules: Fraud rules are checked in order: amount above {threshold} → decline HIGH_AMOUNT; else category GAMBLING → decline BLOCKED_CATEGORY; else approve. Choose the expected action for each rule (column).
dt.missing: Missing columns: {cols} — these combinations need tests too.
dt.wrong: Wrong action in columns: {cols}. Remember: the rules are checked in order.
dt.minimisedLead: Minimised table: with a high amount the category does not matter ("–"), so two columns merge into one.
state.title: Card state transitions
state.rules: Model from the requirements: {attempts} wrong CVVs in a row or blocking by the owner move ACTIVE to BLOCKED; after the expiry date ACTIVE becomes EXPIRED and BLOCKED stays BLOCKED. Only an ACTIVE card can be blocked. Build test cases from events — each test starts in ACTIVE.
state.diagram: Card state diagram: ACTIVE, BLOCKED, EXPIRED
state.invalid: Attempted invalid transitions (the test stops there): {list}.
state.bug13: Exactly this attempt found defect BUG-13 in Card Wallet: the system lets you block an expired card.
cov.title: Statement and branch coverage
cov.rules: This is pseudo-code of real wallet functions. Enter test data — executed lines light up and statement and branch coverage appear below. Branches are all edges of the control flow graph, unconditional ones included. In the fraud program each return ends the function, so its branches are just the 4 decision outcomes.
cov.hint: — one test per line or separated by ";"
